notes.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls Will Be Playable For The First Time At Evo 2025!
notes.content:
The previously announced Arc System Works Marvel title, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, has been confirmed to be playable at the Arc booth on the showroom floor.

The previously announced collaboration between three titans of gaming, PlayStation XDEV, Arc System Works and Marvel Games, has finally been pulled further into the light following its exciting reveal at Sony’s State of Play June 2025 presentation. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls will be fully playable at the biggest fighting game event of the year, Evo 2025. Sony revealed the plans over on the PlayStation Blog, and the title will be playable from the showroom floor, exclusively at the Arc System Works booth. The first (and only so far) trailer for the upcoming fighter can be seen below.
